name: Typewriter line
oneLiner: a close-up of a sheet in a typewriter under a warm lamp: the line types out key by key in uneven ink, the carriage stepping left on every stroke as the two-colour ribbon jumps to the strike and the keys go down, then the return lever throws the carriage back and the platen feeds the paper up a line
say: when the speaker talks about writing something or reads out the first line ('it starts with one sentence', 'I wrote the script first', 'here is the line I opened with'): the line types as they say it and the carriage returns on the last word
